entries.EN: Is there anybody willing to go hunting?
entries.JA_current: Is there anybody willing to go hunting?
entries.JA_new: 狩りに行きたい奴いるか？
いい獲物だ！

entries.EN: Is anybody interested in mutant parts?
entries.JA_current: Is anybody interested in mutant parts?
entries.JA_new: ミュータントの部位が欲しい奴はいないか？

entries.EN: Are there any brave stalkers willing to go hunting?
entries.JA_current: Are there any brave stalkers willing to go hunting?
entries.JA_new: 腕に覚えのあるストーカー、狩りに行かないか？

entries.EN: One can earn a lot, if not a coward!
entries.JA_current: One can earn a lot, if not a coward!
entries.JA_new: 腰抜けじゃなきゃ大儲けできるぞ！

entries.EN: Hunting time! Anybody wanna join? It ain't to be done alone, you know...
entries.JA_current: Hunting time! Anybody wanna join? It ain't to be done alone, you know...
entries.JA_new: 狩りの時間だ！誰か一緒に来るか？　一人でやるのは無謀だぞ……

entries.EN: There's a nice chance to make good money! Not for the chicken-hearted...
entries.JA_current: There's a nice chance to make good money! Not for the chicken-hearted...
entries.JA_new: ひと稼ぎするチャンスだ！　臆病者には無理だけどな……
誰かの白骨が転がってる……
気を抜くなよ！

entries.EN: Who's with me to waste the scum?
entries.JA_current: Who's with me to waste the scum?
entries.JA_new: クズどもを片づけるぞ。誰か来るか？

entries.EN: Somebody's got torn to bits, it seems...
entries.JA_current: Somebody's got torn to bits, it seems...
entries.JA_new: 誰かがバラバラにされたみたいだ……

entries.EN: No way am I going there alone! God save my bacon.
entries.JA_current: No way am I going there alone! God save my bacon.
entries.JA_new: こんな場所、一人じゃ行けないって！　どうか無事でいられますように。

entries.EN: Anybody feel like going on a safari?
entries.JA_current: Anybody feel like going on a safari?
entries.JA_new: サファリに行きたい奴いるか？
周りをよく見ろ！
危なかった！

entries.EN: I almost thought that was the end... Barely managed to save my ass!
entries.JA_current: I almost thought that was the end... Barely managed to save my ass!
entries.JA_new: もう終わりかと思った……なんとか逃げ延びたぜ！

entries.EN: I took a roundabout way so as not to get in harm's way.
entries.JA_current: I took a roundabout way so as not to get in harm's way.
entries.JA_new: 危険を避けて遠回りした。
あそこは気をつけろ。
用心しろ！
あそこには近づかない方がいい。
今は通れない。

entries.EN: It's preferable to avoid that place.
entries.JA_current: It's preferable to avoid that place.
entries.JA_new: あそこは避けた方がいい。
運が味方してくれた！

entries.EN: Blood splatters... Scraps of flesh and guts... Somebody's had a bad day...
entries.JA_current: Blood splatters... Scraps of flesh and guts... Somebody's had a bad day...
entries.JA_new: 血しぶき……肉片と臓物……誰か大変な目に遭ったみたいだ……

entries.EN: What to do.. That is the question!
entries.JA_current: What to do.. That is the question!
entries.JA_new: どうしたもんかな……それが問題だ。

entries.EN: Shit luck! No way through there...
entries.JA_current: Shit luck! No way through there...
entries.JA_new: ちくしょう、ついてないな……ここは通れそうにない。
危険に気をつけろ！

entries.EN: It's nothing more than a waste of time.
entries.JA_current: It's nothing more than a waste of time.
entries.JA_new: 時間の無駄だ。

entries.EN: Naah... This ain't a way to make money. Won't even pay for the ammo.
entries.JA_current: Naah... This ain't a way to make money. Won't even pay for the ammo.
entries.JA_new: いや……金にならないな。弾代にもならない。

entries.EN: Are you suggesting we hunt together? Thanks, but I'm out. No time for trifles.
entries.JA_current: Are you suggesting we hunt together? Thanks, but I'm out. No time for trifles.
entries.JA_new: 一緒に狩りに行かないかって？　悪いけどパスだ。つまらないことに構ってる暇はない。
たいしたことない……

entries.EN: Are you asking to hunt together? Hmm... Why not!
entries.JA_current: Are you asking to hunt together? Hmm... Why not!
entries.JA_new: 一緒に狩りに行くのか？　うーん……いいぜ！

entries.EN: Where was that, you say? Send me the coordinates and lets hunt!
entries.JA_current: Where was that, you say? Send me the coordinates and lets hunt!
entries.JA_new: 場所はどこだ？　座標を送ってくれ。すぐ狩りに行こう！

entries.EN: I may join. Way more fun to do this in a group!
entries.JA_current: I may join. Way more fun to do this in a group!
entries.JA_new: 俺も行こうかな。みんなでやる方が楽しいしな！

entries.EN: I would like to join the hunt, if you don't mind.
entries.JA_current: I would like to join the hunt, if you don't mind.
entries.JA_new: 迷惑じゃなければ、俺も狩りに参加したい。

entries.EN: So many of them! Everywhere you walk! Lets waste them! Anybody coming along?!
entries.JA_current: So many of them! Everywhere you walk! Lets waste them! Anybody coming along?!
entries.JA_new: そこら中にいやがる！　片っ端から片づけようぜ！　誰か来るか？！

entries.EN: So many... High time to wipe them out!
entries.JA_current: So many... High time to wipe them out!
entries.JA_new: 多すぎる……そろそろ一掃しないとな！
うーん……何かおかしいな。

entries.EN: Where the hell do they come from? So many of them! They must be put down before they become a real threat.
entries.JA_current: Where the hell do they come from? So many of them! They must be put down before they become a real threat.
entries.JA_new: どこからこんなに湧いてくるんだ？　本当の脅威になる前に始末しないと。

entries.EN: Damn it... No way to poke around in there now...
entries.JA_current: Damn it... No way to poke around in there now...
entries.JA_new: くそっ……これじゃ中を調べられない。

entries.EN: Shit! Just when I needed to pass through there! Is there anybody around heading the same way? Maybe we can partner up and punch through.
entries.JA_current: Shit! Just when I needed to pass through there! Is there anybody around heading the same way? Maybe we can partner up and punch through.
entries.JA_new: ちくしょう、通りたい時に限ってこれか！　同じ方向へ行く奴はいないか？　組んで突破しよう。

entries.EN: So many of them... Where do they keep coming from?..
entries.JA_current: So many of them... Where do they keep coming from?..
entries.JA_new: 多すぎる……いったいどこから湧いてくるんだ……

entries.EN: Fuck! What should I do now?
entries.JA_current: Fuck! What should I do now?
entries.JA_new: くそっ！　これからどうすりゃいい？

entries.EN: Guys! Whoever's got the balls, lets clean up area! Anybody eager to do a noble deed?
entries.JA_current: Guys! Whoever's got the balls, lets clean up area! Anybody eager to do a noble deed?
entries.JA_new: おい！　肝の据わった奴、ここを片づけるぞ！　人助けに乗り気な奴はいないか？
